Catch or throw: Neither: the token passes straight through
Use it when: The process reaches a state you want to name or measure

Catch or throw: Catch only: start, intermediate, or boundary
Use it when: A business condition becomes true at a moment nobody can predict
Velora example: Stock available for order; start: Credit exposure above 90% of limit

Catch or throw: Throw, then catch, as a named pair
Use it when: One diagram needs a page or row break
